arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Dabney argued the patent claim is broadly worded. He stated the Solicitor General agrees it is invalid.
Mr. Hungar argued the motivation test is bad policy. He claimed it produces wrong answers in cases like this.
Mr. Goldstein referenced the supplemental joint appendix. He promised to quote from the provided documents.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: KSR International wants the Court to reject the rigid motivation test. They argue this test wrongly protects weak patents.
Teleflex wants the Court to keep the strict test. They argue this test provides clear rules for patent validity.
